title: The Sterling Scrimmage
motive_summary: Accidental escalation of professional rivalry, leading to murder when reputation and career were at stake.
overview_text: <discovered_by_name> found Eleanor Vance collapsed in the Brenda Quill's House & Yard. The victim was slumped near a side table, having sustained several deep cuts. Lying just beside the body was Brass till weight, highly polished and easily mistaken for an everyday decorative item. Initial forensic assessment suggested the attack was swift and brutal, giving little time for struggle or defense.
